notes:
What's new

- Fixed a crash when opening a Word, Excel, PowerPoint or EPUB file that is empty or damaged: the app now shows its usual 'can't open this' card instead of closing.
- A damaged PDF no longer opens as gibberish text; it reports that it could not be read.
- The sample book that shipped with the previewer is now a real EPUB.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.24 - pre-release QA sweep. Fixed a stack-overflow crash in the Office engine (ReadPart recursed into itself for any container that could not be extracted, since 1.3.17) and stopped known binary families from falling through to text sniffing (truncated PDFs opened as mojibake). Added tests/release_audit.py (427 checks over 131 files, doc types, drawn pixels, per-family interactions) and tests/scenario_audit.py (45 checks: empty/truncated inputs, unicode paths, extreme sizes, repeated opens, clipboard, single instance, hygiene); both run in production_check.
